A '''secretary''' was an occupation. [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ruler of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], had two secretaries, [[Lyn (secretary)|Lyn]] and [[Perspik]], assigned to him.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> Within [[Geelan]] society, each nest appointed a secretary to assist in handling the group's business affairs.
